_comment: LIVE catalog for the Free TV app. Editing this file changes the app's channels with no release. Channels with kind=scheduled are our own: a published running order the app resolves to whatever should be on air now. 'Space' is NASA footage and 'Deep Sea' NOAA footage, US federal government works and public domain by statute. 'Night Sky' is ESO and NSF NOIRLab footage and 'Animation' the Blender open movies, all Creative Commons Attribution: every item carries a 'credit' line the app shows on screen, which the licence requires. No source's logo or insignia may be used as channel art, and nothing may imply any of them endorses the app. The curation record for each channel (page, licence, exclusions and why) lives in the app repo under tools/channels/. Run check-streams.sh before committing.
